summary: Iteration-6 targeted backend regression of the 4 fixes, against https://trade-network-27.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py (17 tests). Full run: 107 tests, 103 passed, 4 failed. FIX 1 (token revocation) VERIFIED: DELETE /account -> same JWT gives 401 on GET /auth/me and 401 on POST /listings; a user flipped to role='suspended' directly in Mongo also gets 401 on /auth/me and /listings. The iteration-5 failing test test_delete_account_revokes_old_token now PASSES. FIX 2 (username) VERIFIED: 'ab' -> 422, 'Bad!Chars' -> 422, 21-char -> 422, valid 'good_xxxxxxxx' -> 200 and persists via /auth/me, duplicate across two accounts -> 409 'Username already taken' (loser keeps old username), re-saving your OWN username is still 200 (no self-409), and users.username unique+sparse index exists in index_information(). FIX 3 (whitespace) PARTIALLY VERIFIED: POST /trades/{id}/messages with '   ' -> 422 and padded text is stripped in the stored/returned message (200, text=='TEST_i6 padded trade msg'). POST /conversations/{other}/messages with '   ' -> 422 with 'blank' in detail and no dm_messages row, BUT the conversation document is still upserted first with last_message='   ' (dirty write on a 422), and for a valid padded message the msg.text is stripped while conversations.last_message is NOT (stored '   TEST_i6 padded   ') so the conversation list shows unstripped text. FIX 4 (prefs) HALF DONE: the EMAIL side works — notify_messages=false suppresses email_queue direct_message rows and notify_trades=false suppresses trade_proposal rows, and flipping notify_messages back to true re-queues the email; but the IN-APP side is NOT wired: with notify_messages=false the recipient still gets the 'message' notification, and with notify_trades=false the recipient still gets the 'trade_proposal' notification. _should_notify/_add_notification (server.py:132-154) exist but are DEAD CODE — grep shows zero call sites; all 8 notification creations still use raw db.notifications.insert_one. No preference leakage: a sender who mutes themselves does not suppress the recipient's notification or email (verified). Regression: backend_test.py (29) + test_iteration4.py (39) + test_iteration5.py (22) = 90/90 PASS, up from 89/90. Backend logs clean, zero tracebacks/500s.

minor.issue: In-app notification preferences still not honoured. _add_notification()/_should_notify() at server.py:132-154 are never called; every notification is created with a raw db.notifications.insert_one (server.py:740, 803, 815, 820, 830, 850, 877, 1125). Verified: notify_messages=false still yields a 'message' notification, notify_trades=false still yields a 'trade_proposal' notification. Only the email_queue path (_queue_email) honours the prefs. FAILING TESTS: test_iteration6.py::test_notify_messages_false_suppresses_inapp_and_email, ::test_notify_trades_false_suppresses_trade_proposal. Fix: replace all 8 raw inserts with await _add_notification(...).

Blank-text validation happens AFTER the conversation upsert (server.py:1102-1123), so a whitespace-only send returns 422 but still creates/updates the conversation with last_message='   ' — a phantom conversation with a blank preview. Also last_message uses the raw inp.text[:140] instead of the stripped text, so a padded valid message stores '   TEST_i6 padded   ' while msg.text is stripped. Fix: compute text = inp.text.strip() and raise 422 BEFORE the upsert, then use the stripped value for both last_message and the notification preview. FAILING TESTS: test_dm_whitespace_only_422, test_dm_whitespace_stripped_and_stored.

notify_matches is persisted and returned by /auth/me but there is no match notification or 'match' email anywhere in server.py (grep: no _queue_email(..., 'match', ...) call site), so the toggle is unobservable/inert by construction.

action_items: Route ALL in-app notifications through _add_notification() (currently dead code) so notify_messages/notify_trades/notify_matches actually gate db.notifications inserts — 8 raw insert_one sites listed above.

In send_dm, strip and validate the text BEFORE the conversations upsert, and store the stripped text in last_message (and in the notification preview) — today a 422 still creates a conversation with a blank last_message.
Either emit match notifications/emails or drop notify_matches from ProfileUpdate so the Settings UI stops advertising a no-op toggle.

Still open from earlier iterations: split server.py (1217 lines) into APIRouter modules; unknown trade_id returns 403 instead of 404 on /trades/{id}/messages and several HTTPExceptions have no detail string (server.py:726, 793, 795, 813, 821, 835); trade 'cancel'/'complete' are not status-guarded so a completed trade can be re-completed and double-increment successful_trades; db.email_queue has no index/consumer.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1102 — the conversations upsert is a side effect executed before input validation; any validation added later will keep leaking dirty writes. Validate first, mutate after.
server.py:132-154 — _should_notify/_add_notification are unreferenced. Dead helpers give the false impression the preference feature is implemented; wire them in or delete them.
server.py:459 — `import re` inside update_profile on every request; move to module scope (re is already imported at 635-ish usage sites via local imports too).

get_current_user now raises 401 for role in ('deleted','suspended') in both the JWT and session branches — good — but get_optional_user swallows it, so public GET /users/{id} still resolves soft-deleted accounts (200, display_name '[deleted]'). Consider 404/410 for role=='deleted'.
PATCH /profile still drops None values, so nullable fields (store_tagline, banner_photo, payment handles) cannot be cleared with null.

success_rate.backend: 96.3% (103/107: iteration-6 suite 13/17, iteration-5 22/22, iteration-4 39/39, legacy 29/29 — the 90-test regression baseline is now 90/90)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral users prefixed TEST_i6 (password Passw0rd!23) created per run; all listings created by the suite are deleted on teardown. Two soft-deleted (role=deleted) and one suspended (role=suspended) TEST_i6 user row remain by design, plus a few email_queue/dm_messages/conversations rows (harmless).
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md — self-registration via POST /api/auth/signup, password Passw0rd!23. No seeded admin, so /api/admin/* remains untested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v (pytest.ini sets -n 2 --dist loadscope). Four suites now: backend_test.py (29), test_iteration4.py (39), test_iteration5.py (22) — all green — and test_iteration6.py (17, 4 failing on the two real defects above: in-app notification prefs not wired, DM conversation upsert before blank validation + unstripped last_message). test_iteration6.py talks to Mongo directly via pymongo (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env) to assert email_queue rows, the users.username unique index, and to set role='suspended'. STILL NOT COVERED: /api/admin/* (needs a seeded admin), /api/upload + /api/files/{id}, /api/reports, Google OAuth session flow, needs-board urgency filtering, and the ENTIRE frontend UI (never tested in iterations 1-6 — biggest remaining gap).
rca_of_the_issue: (1) Preference gating was implemented only inside _queue_email; the parallel in-app path was refactored into _add_notification/_should_notify but no call site was migrated, so every db.notifications.insert_one still fires unconditionally. Reproduce: signup A+B, PATCH /profile {notify_messages:false} as B, A DMs B, GET /notifications as B -> notification present while email_queue stays empty. (2) send_dm upserts the conversation (with the raw, unstripped text as last_message) at server.py:1102 and only strips/validates at 1117-1123, so the 422 path leaves a conversation whose preview is whitespace, and the success path stores unstripped last_message. Reproduce: POST /conversations/{b}/messages {'text':'   '} -> 422, then read db.conversations -> last_message == '   '.
